1.w: Sing to YHWH a new song; sing to YHWH, all the earth!

2.w: Sing to YHWH, bless His name; give the news from day to day of His salvation!

3.w: Recount among the nations His glory, among all the peoples His wonders.

4.w: For great [is] YHWH, and to be praised greatly; He [is] to be feared above all gods.

5.w: For all the gods of the peoples [are] idols, and YHWH made the heavens.

6.w: Splendor and majesty [are] before His face; strength and beauty [are] in His sanctuary.

7.w: Give to YHWH, O families of the peoples, give to YHWH honor and strength!

8.w: Give to YHWH the glory [due] His name; lift up an offering and come into His courts!

9.w: Bow down before YHWH in the splendor of [His] holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth!

10.w: Say among the nations, “YHWH reigns!” Surely the world is firmly set—it cannot be shaken; He will judge the peoples with uprightness.

11.w: Let the heavens rejoice and let the earth be glad; let the sea and its fullness roar!

12.w: Let the field be joyful, and all that [is] in it! Then all the trees of the forest will shout for joy,

13.w: before YHWH, for He is coming—for He is coming to judge the earth! He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.
